Halfway through Day 1 of YCS San Diego, and we have an equal number of SPYRAL and Trickstar Decks?! While most Duelists are saying SPYRAL is the number one strategy, many are turning to Trickstars as a way to counter them. Since Trickstars already play
, and both cards individually help in the matchup, the Trickstars have a built-in advantage. Add that to the fact that they can easily find space for cards like
, and you’ve got a strong matchup against SPYRAL.

Other than those two, there’s quite a bit of variety in the top Decks. Pendulum Magicians, True Draco, Dinosaurs, and Invoked are all strategies we’ve seen over the last few months. Darklords are certainly a surprise though!
